text: {"assertions":["A 401 authentication storm was discovered in services/auth/token_refresh.py on 2026-05-08.","The 401 storm only affected sessions that arrived through an OAuth provider.","The issue was reproducible by allowing an access token to expire mid-session.","An off-by-one error in a slice bound was identified as the root cause.","The bug manifested as a burst of unauthorized responses visible in the access log.","The nightly rollup data showed incorrect counts for 29 days before the fix was discovered.","The fix involved correcting the slice bound and adding a property test around it.","The fix was submitted as PR #1336 on the branch fix/401-storm-1."]}
